takes.prompt: The red-haired woman finishes a small gentle drying wipe on the cream cup, keeping the mug in her anatomical LEFT hand and the grey towel in her RIGHT throughout. She lowers her RIGHT towel hand to her own right hip, then makes a small controlled LEFT-wrist turn so the same physical mug handle changes from its held right-facing orientation toward the final left-facing orientation. Her LEFT fingers maintain causal grip; the handle travels with the mug body rather than sliding through it. She lowers the cup under LEFT-hand support until its base contacts the counter beside the existing cup, then softly releases the same hand. The towel stays in her RIGHT hand on viewer-left; no handoff or grip ownership swap occurs. Preserve connected wrists and fingers, stable existing far cup, rack, counter and room. Her face remains depleted and distant; the watching man makes only a slight concerned forward inclination. Same fixed camera and cold drawn kitchen, natural deliberate continuous action without a cheerful smile.

action_contract.story_beat: Ordinary exactness and human distance deepen his dread.
action_contract.before: Her LEFT hand holds the cup while her RIGHT wipes with a towel.
action_contract.action: Finish drying, lower the towel hand, slowly rotate the supported mug with the same LEFT hand, lower and set its base on the counter, then release.
action_contract.after: Two cups rest supported on the counter; LEFT fingertips come away, RIGHT retains the towel; emotional unavailability persists.

takes.prompt: The same spiky-haired bearded keyboardist plays the silver arranger in one controlled flowing phrase. Both hands approach the keybed from the player side, rounded fingers visibly depressing and releasing nearby keys in small differentiated movements, not rigid hands sliding as a block or hovering. His wrist makes a modest lift/reposition toward the next nearby notes and settles back onto the keybed while his head inclines slightly with absorbed concentration. Preserve all fingers and connected arms, stable silver keyboard width, black central display, outer speaker grilles and controls, supported X stand and his unique silver cross, face, beard, jacket and shirt. The camera remains steady; compact natural torso/breath motion supports real playing without a repetitive large head nod or whole-scene camera drift.

action_contract.story_beat: The intro instrument supplies a separate human performance pulse beside the film narrative.
action_contract.before: Both rounded hands touch the silver keybed in a supported playing posture.
action_contract.action: Depress and release nearby keys, lift/reposition a wrist slightly and continue the phrase with small absorbed head inclination.
action_contract.after: Hands remain naturally at the same instrument; face and costume stay stable, performance continues.

takes.prompt: In one restrained fixed-camera close two-person anime shot, the seated red-haired woman lets a small settling breath pass and raises her chin and eyes slightly from the cup toward the man at or near screen-left. Her mouth remains closed and flat, eyes depleted and affect emotionally unavailable; this is not a warm responding look. The brown-haired man watches her with a tiny widening of his eyes and slight parting of his lips as fear becomes recognition. Preserve coherent head/neck anatomy, seated shoulders, the same relaxed hand resting on the table, upright cup base and handle, table/cabinet geometry and ordinary cold kitchen light. No new tear trails or smile arise in this shot. Tiny real breath, eyelid and chin motion must occur continuously, not a face redraw or camera drift.

action_contract.story_beat: He recognizes the practiced composure at the lyric climax, without depicting a method or inevitable outcome.
action_contract.before: Her chin/eyes are lowered near the upright cup; he studies her quietness.
action_contract.action: A small settling breath and chin/eye lift toward or near him remain unresponsive while his eyes widen with recognition.
action_contract.after: She is still closed and depleted, mouth flat; he remains frightened and newly aware.

takes.prompt: In one slow intimate fixed-camera drawn anime shot, the seated red-haired woman begins with heavy lowered eyes and her relaxed hand supported beside the upright mug. Moisture gradually gathers at the lower eyelids; one or two small translucent tear tracks develop naturally downward over her cheeks. She gently raises and turns her head only a few degrees toward the man at screen-left and looks at him with wet eyes, a minutely pinched brow and vulnerable slightly unsteady parted lips. Preserve this quiet eye contact and small tears through the ending, without dropping her gaze again or adding a smile, nod or broad expression reset. The man remains beside her with exhausted contained care and a soft responsive look, without an embrace or reassuring grin. Same face, freckles, hair, story clothes, round pendants, hand ownership, unmoving supported mug and table, ordinary kitchen light. Coherent gradual eye/head/breath movement; tears begin at eyelids, not random skin or glowing lines. Emotional contact remains ambiguous grief and possible opening, not a triumphant cure.

action_contract.story_beat: A fragile breach of emotional closure arrives through tears and sustained attention, with no explained cure.
action_contract.before: Eyes downcast, hand beside supported cup, no clear tear trails.
action_contract.action: Eyes moisten and small tears form as she lifts and turns her gaze toward him with vulnerable mouth and brow.
action_contract.after: She sustains quiet tearful eye contact; his presence stays caring and uncertain, with no smile or gaze undo.
